operational.targets: One creature, object or location you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect; alternatively, one specific course of action you are considering beginning within the next minute in the current situation.
operational.resolution: No roll. The Director gives one brief, truthful, cryptic but usable phrase or sentence about the most immediately relevant circumstance, danger, opportunity or likely consequence connected to the chosen subject or proposed action.
operational.effect: Only you perceive and understand the whisper. It supplies a supernatural clue from current circumstances, including relevant hidden circumstances when their disclosure is permitted; it is not merely a cosmetic noise. Its wording may be symbolic but must convey a usable clue rather than deliberately contradict the relevant facts. No deity, spirit, speaker or binding promise is established. Recasting a materially equivalent inquiry about the same subject or proposed action while the materially relevant circumstances remain unchanged gives the same omen or a restatement, without cumulative extra detail. This equivalence applies across casters: rephrasing the inquiry, passing it to another caster, or subdividing it solely to extract additional detail about the same issue does not create new information. A genuinely different material question about that subject, or a material change in circumstances, may produce a different omen.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in targets, range, duration or information.
operational.limitations: It does not guarantee future decisions, dice or events not yet caused, compel anyone to enact a predicted outcome, reveal a whole stat block/inventory/plot or automatically succeed at a task. New voluntary actions or genuinely new causes may make a previously truthful omen obsolete. Rephrasing the same inquiry, switching casters or serially subdividing it does not create extra information from an unchanged omen; use the same materially equivalent subject/circumstance boundary. No additional daily use cap is added. If all relevant information is specifically protected, the Director gives only an uninformative opaque omen without naming the protection; permitted information about other subjects remains available. Actual class access and repertoire, audible V/free-hand S components, casting sequence, Refrain/Dissonance, class hooks and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Base RP is 0 but repeated cantrips still follow their actual strain rules. No automatic upcast or unstated scaling. Source-specific protections apply only to their actual scope. Protection from Scrying prevents new Divination/Scrying information about its protected subject, including beneficial inspection, but grants no blanket immunity to damage, buffs or other noninformational mechanics merely because of their school; it does not erase already-known facts or ordinary records.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/30feet/V,S/instantaneous and a cryptic supernatural tip. NEW: bounded subject/action input, one truthful usable private clue, current-circumstances scope and no incremental detail for materially repeated inquiry. No universal future-certainty or spirit-contact ability.

operational.effect: For the duration, understand the literal semantic meaning of ordinary spoken and written languages you perceive within 30 feet. You do not gain the ability to speak or write those languages unless you already could.
operational.scaling: None. Damage dice, target count, range and duration do not automatically increase with character or class level.
operational.limitations: Does not decipher codes, ciphers, secret cant, intentionally obfuscated wording, magical glyph functions, command words, proper names lacking translation, cultural subtext, metaphor beyond literal meaning, or information hidden by an explicit magical protection. It cannot translate speech you cannot hear or text you cannot perceive. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
operational.designNotes: Core V2 blocks and catalog summaries are preserved alongside this card. Components use the existing class focus where Core says F or M/F; this focus interpretation is provisional. Exact target eligibility, duration endpoints, saves where absent, concentration where unclear and anti-loop limits are provisional integration decisions. Core instantaneous metadata cannot sustain the described perception; this pilot uses explicit concentration for up to10minutes. The30ft range limits perception of spell-granted information.

operational.targets: One perceived corpse or substantial apparent creature remains within 60 feet and line of effect; eligibility of its deceased identity and retained memories resolves after casting costs commit.
operational.duration: Up to 1 minute or until five question exchanges are spent; no concentration. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; outside initiative, expires 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the original virtual marker or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. An already-passed start never counts.
operational.resolution: No save or willing-soul gate. After costs commit, determine whether these are sufficient actual remains of one currently dead creature identity to support an associated retained memory echo. Bones or equivalent substantial creature remains can qualify without an intact mouth, tongue or biological flesh. An active Undead/Construct, an ordinary broken device that was never a creature, identityless ash, a stray blood trace or old remains of a currently living identity do not qualify. If no readable qualifying echo exists, obtain no answers without learning which eligibility/protection fact failed.
operational.effect: Invoke a retained memory echo associated with the addressed remains and deceased identity, not a soul, creature or resurrection. For this application you may spend up to five question exchanges. Each attempted materially unified inquiry and its answer uses one Action in initiative, or approximately six elapsed seconds outside initiative, and one question allowance; the original casting Action includes no free question. Distinct independent subquestions require their own exchanges, Actions and allowances even when spoken as one sentence. You must audibly address the remains from within 60 feet and line of effect; ordinary sound-blocking conditions apply. Each committed exchange spends its allowance even if the question is not understood or its answer is unknown/protected. The echo answers audibly from the remains, truthfully according to the deceased’s actual associated memories and beliefs before death. It uses a language the deceased knew and would reasonably use, with no automatic translation. If no mutually usable language or remembered answer supports a response, it may provide no intelligible answer, I do not know, I do not remember, or the appropriate equivalent. It cannot deliberately lie or withhold a known readable answer from hostility, but mistaken beliefs remain mistaken.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, uses or information.
operational.limitations: Actual memories associated with the remains govern: this grants no post-death knowledge or automatic later-life memory update to an older fragment after resurrection and another death. Multiple fragments remain one deceased identity, not new people or duplicated souls. A fresh legal paid cast can ask another five; no daily immunity or exclusive global interview slot is added. Each application retains its own quota and deadline; asking an echo does not simultaneously question all other applications. The echo ends if the identity becomes living, the selected physical anchor no longer contains qualifying remains, the five exchanges are spent, or the spell expires/is actually ended. A temporary gap in speaking/range/sound/line of effect pauses no duration. Existing answers and ordinary remembered information persist after ending. Soul Bind or a resurrection-only blocker does not automatically block this memory echo; actual corpse, communication, memory or information protections keep their written scope. The spell generates Divination through Cleric, Mirrorsage, Ranger, Shaman, Wizard or Paladin, and Necromancy through Crimson Agent, Druid or Thief, exactly as the selected casting class’s access row states. A Divination-only ward cannot block a Necromancy cast merely because this shared identity has another school placement. Protection may also filter new information about a separately protected subject within its actual scope. No compelled living creature, identity creation, body animation, healing, resource refresh, skill/proficiency download, objective-history verification or usable recording token results. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Commit costs before the counter window; failed, blocked and countered effects do not refund costs or restore prior concentration. Use the actual casting class's school and rank. Specific information protections apply to their actual subjects and generating-source scope. Hidden unprotected facts are readable; undefined facts are not invented. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: both rank-three Divination/Necromancy source placements and five questions/answers; Core M/F uses shared F. NEW: retained-memory echo, substantial-remains eligibility, truthful subjective answers and one-minute interview. Exact completions put hidden eligibility after payment, require separate paid Action/question exchanges after casting, retain local audible inquiry/range, and bind memories to the actual associated remains rather than silently updating old fragments across later lives.

operational.resolution: The target makes a Wisdom save against your spell save DC. On failure, it has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the spell ends. On success, no effect.

operational.duration: Up to 1 minute or until the next qualifying check; no concentration. operational.resolution: Guide applies automatically to a willing target and grants +1 to its next qualifying Resonance/Weave task check. operational.effect: A qualifying event is a real source-authorized task/ability/tool check explicitly concerned with manipulating, diagnosing, stabilizing, calibrating or directly interacting with Resonance/the Weave, or expressly called a Resonance check by its source. Guide’s +1 follows the strongest-applicable-flat-bonus rule. Disturb’s single -1 is a penalty and can coexist with a separately permitted bonus, such as Resonance Mote’s +1, under ordinary arithmetic. One pending Resonance Whisper per target across all casters; a successful Guide application or failed target Disturb save replaces its old mode and endpoint. A successful target Disturb save creates no replacement and leaves an existing valid rider intact.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in damage, range, duration, targets, uses or information.

paragraphs.label: Effect and operation
paragraphs.text: A completed blank carrier can encode one authentic, completed operational spell/ritual of rank at most 3; it allows 1 lifetime legal cast start(s), always of that same payload, plus +1 relevant research. Record exact spell/version/rank/class placement and genuine source access. A trained Calligrapher uses INT, the real desk/kit, max(1, rank) active hours, that many sp and 0.01 lb per hour of actual encoding supplies, and DC 10 + rank Core task binary resolution. Failure consumes time/supplies; encoding earns no crafting XP or Forge Dwarf reduction. No overwrite, capacity multiplication or refill. SC-03 expressly adds one-cast temporary repertoire only for a reader with the actual class/list, level/rank, RP, component and other spell eligibility. Use the spell's own action/time, range, concentration and cadence; pay one script use and normal resources at cast commitment. Counterspell can stop that paid cast; ready/release creates no second cast. The readable open script must be handled or supported within 5 feet; spell hands/components remain mandatory. Copying words does not copy magical uses. The research bonus requires the actual relevant lead consultation under SC-05. SC-01–05 and SC-10 govern the full procedure. These research/navigation bonuses apply only to their genuinely relevant recorded subject and actual eligible information task. They do not improve attacks, saves, spell DCs, spellcasting, unrelated checks, manufacture or repair. The item's own authoring, copying or encoding, and creation of a new bonus-granting reference from that same item, receive no self-production bonus. Genuine relevant formula research remains separately eligible without guaranteeing discovery.

paragraphs.label: Complete output bodies
paragraphs.text: Choose before any work: SC-book: Existing Book reference, NEW 200 writable pages/12x9x3-inch binding. No supplied factual content. 25 gp, 5 lb, ordinary B5, structural AC 15, dimensions 12 × 9 × 3 inches. See the complete body catalogue for original primaries, constituent masses, hands, capacity and support. A creature output replaces stock object HP/AC with its printed creature statistics. EN alternate weapon/suit hosts use their exact registered existing equipment profile; these default figures do not overwrite that alternate body.

paragraphs.label: Before creation
paragraphs.text: Reserve 1 actual complete never-magically-altered bodies, one model/size per order, in an exclusive fixed order. All must be complete and positive-HP immediately before the completion roll, even if fewer outputs will result. Bodies are additional to the exact source batch components and working tools. Pre-roll lawful replacement keeps its ordered position; no post-roll acquisition, substitution or reordering. Transform the first resolved outputs; unused bodies remain actual mundane stock. Record material identity, condition, real storage, actual station capacity, preservation and safe handling; a quoted price supplies none of those facts.

paragraphs.label: Creation check and work
paragraphs.text: Scribing level 5; INT with actual Calligrapher's supplies training, one PB or replacing expertise, DC 15. Untrained otherwise eligible level 1–4 uses no tool PB and disadvantage; trained recipe eligibility is max(4, trade level), with actual formula access. Only actual incorporated inputs stabilize; raw/returned catalyst clocks continue. Interruption loses unfinished-phase progress, not costs or completed work.

paragraphs.label: Facility and assistance

Fixed compatible facilities, actual minimum surface/bay/fixtures, safe access and expedition-site permissions remain required. Maximum 0 eligible assistants work all required hours without shortening the task or gaining assistant XP. Ordinary facilities/tools grant +0. Two active work Watches, no overlapping labor/rest credit, actual hired capacity and lawful access still apply.

paragraphs.label: Formula and advancement

paragraphs.label: Manufacturing outcomes
paragraphs.text: Mishap 0; Failed 0; Flawed 1; Standard 1; Exceptional yield 1; Masterwork yield 1. Natural 1 is Mishap; natural 20 adds no band shift. An eligible Forge Dwarf's Standard becomes Exceptional. Alternatively retain 1 structural objects with the strongest P25/P50 workmanship once. Maximum = B + max(1, floor(B×P/100)) for positive P, else B; one existing/new singleton persistent flaw halves last, minimum 1. Preserve old maximum minus current damage deficit, clamping the new current to [0,newMax]. Q1 Flawed creates one persistent flaw; Q≥2 reduced yield adds no new singleton flaw, even when one output remains. Standard never heals. Actual EN host size/grade B takes precedence over default-body examples. No outcome improves charges, potency, source DC, spell rank, capacities or permissions; later repair does not remove a flaw or reapply manufacturing quality.

paragraphs.label: Retention and failure
paragraphs.text: This recipe has no eligible catalyst-return occurrence. On Failed creation, for each eligible exact consumed non-catalyst input identity, recover at most one quarter of its fixed consumed-input quantity for this batch, capped by the eligible amount actually remaining from those same inputs, and rounded down once to that identity's legal source-unit precision. Do not take one quarter of the surviving remainder. Previously returned, forfeited or lost quantities and unrelated stock cannot fund this recovery. For each exact eligible identity in this batch, use `recovered_i = u_i × floor(min(Q_i / 4, R_i) / u_i)`. Q_i is its fixed consumed-input quantity; R_i is the eligible amount surviving from those same inputs; u_i is its legal source-unit precision. Group only genuinely identical eligible inputs within this same batch while retaining every physical occurrence. Catalysts and unrelated batches do not enter that recovery group. The per-occurrence record identifies only expressly divisible bulk; otherwise floor to indivisible units. No quarter tool/lens/core, money conversion, duplicate catalyst, or second salvage pass over waste. Mishap/abandonment returns no consumed inputs. Retained working tools and unused complete bodies survive only as they actually exist. Returned material retains real age, vessels and history; a retained catalyst is not also inside the finished item.

paragraphs.label: Restoration and reference prices
paragraphs.text: SC-book: finished unit 342 gp, functional repair material 25/4 gp and default 1 hours at DC 10; recoverable Broken/wreck reconstruction material 171/2 gp and default 8 hours at original DC 15. Recompute actual time from current recorded maximum HP: max(1, maxHP/10) or max(8, maxHP/10). Alternate admitted host price/size/grade uses its actual reference. Trained primary trade + INT, original station/implements and host-compatible repair fixtures are required. Original creation record and all magic-bearing primaries must survive; missing/burnt pages, missing model-designated primary frame/actuator, sacrificed or already-consumed debris are not reconstructible by payment. Core task natural shifts collapse to success/failure; failure spends time/material. Restore only recorded HP and lawful function, never charges/service/spell uses, flaws or prior deadlines. No Forge reduction, quality, extra generic assistants or XP. Reference = original batch market value / original Q + actual body; keep exact fractions until final copper purchase-ceiling/sale-floor. Actual quotes, availability, service and ownership are separate.

Only actual legal commitment spends resources; legal committed misses/prevention/interruption do not refund them. No transfers, snapshots, copies, repair or relabeling reset state. guideText:
# Languages, literacy and communication

**Authored candidate v1 — exact joint review pending.** This chapter implements the LA-01–16 source decisions for ordinary play. Rules marked **NEW** complete gaps in the prior sources. They are provisional game rules; no unfinished spell, feat or class option becomes available through this chapter. Use each acquired feature's actual card for its costs, targets, duration and access.

## Choose starting languages

Apply your base ancestry, your actual variant and your background. A description of who usually speaks a language does not grant it. Record each grant and every choice separately.

| Base ancestry | Starting languages |
|---|---|
| Amphibian | Common, Aquan |
| Umbrin | Common, Elvish, Murkish |
| Drakari | Common, Draconic |
| Dwarf | Common, Dwarvish |
| Elf | Common, Elvish |
| Feykin | Common, Sylvan |
| Gnome | Common, Gnomish |
| Goblin | Common, Goblin |
| Human | Common; one choice |
| Mycelian | Common; one choice common in its actual home region |
| Ogre | Common, Giant |
| Orc | Common, Orcish |
| Troll | Common, Giant |
| Undead | Common; one choice |

High Elf adds one language through Extra Language. Imperial Human adds one through Diplomatic Training. The other 43 variants keep their base language grant. Fungi conversation, animal communication and empathic links remain separate capabilities.

| Background | Additional language grant |
|---|---|
| Aethel City Guard Veteran | None; source has no Languages field |
| Rift Scarred Survivor | One Exotic language (Abyssal, Celestial, Primordial, or Deep Cant, reflecting the Rift's nature) |
| Disgraced Noble Scion | One of your choice |
| Wildling Herbalist | Sylvan or Primordial (choose one) |
| Guild Artisan Dropout | One of your choice |
| Seeker of the Lost Pantheon | Two of your choice (often ancient or obscure ones) |
| Marked Fugitive | One obscure or factional language (e.g., Celestial, Infernal, Forgotten Script) |
| Expedition Cartographer | None; source has no Languages field |
| Arcane Academy Dropout | Two of your choice |
| Cult Escapee | One exotic language (often Abyssal, Infernal, or Deep Cant) |
| Planar Merchant | Two of your choice |
| Battlefield Medic | None; source has no Languages field |
| Dimensional Refugee | Two of your choice |
| Relic Hunter | One of your choice |
| Corruption Survivor | One exotic language (often Abyssal, Infernal, or Deep Cant) |
| Frontier Settler | None; source has no Languages field |
| Prophecy Bearer | Two of your choice |
| Underworld Escapee | None; source has no Languages field |
| Elemental Touched | Primordial (you can choose Auran, Aquan, Ignan, or Terran dialect based on your elemental affinity) |
| Celestial Emissary | Celestial |

Resolve fixed grants first, then choices in a recorded order. **NEW duplicate rule:** two fixed grants of the same language combine their actual modes and keep both sources; they grant no substitute or refund. An unspent choice can select a different eligible language, or genuinely missing modes that its source permits. If no eligible unsatisfied option exists, record the choice as exhausted, with no future credit. A historical choice cannot be changed freely after every rest.

The Director supplies an available choice list and its actual upbringing/contact premise before selection. An explicit starting grant needs no paid course. General choices use supported ordinary population languages; exotic or other cultural options need their actual allowed grant/contact. Abyssal, Celestial and Draconic are printed Exotic examples; **NEW**, Infernal and Primordial are also options for an open Exotic choice. Category descriptions do not create a teacher, faction membership or access to protected writing.

Keep closed alternatives closed: Rift-Scarred Survivor has its four named options; Wildling Herbalist chooses Sylvan or Primordial. “Often” and “e.g.” give examples within a restriction. Mycelian needs an actual home region where the selected language is common. A named Deep Cant starting option remains valid without settling its origins. A generic choice does not bypass a language's actual attunement, class or secret-source restriction.

**Example:** Imperial Human with Seeker of the Lost Pantheon has Common and four separate choices: one Human, one variant and two background. Mira's Battlefield Medic adds no language; her Human Common and chosen Dwarvish remain unchanged. A Troll has Common/Giant, without automatic Trollish.

## Names, dialects and modes

Record spoken comprehension, speaking, reading, writing and script familiarity separately. Knowledge and current ability to use it are different: deafness may stop you hearing a language you know; it does not remove that knowledge.

**NEW permanent-grant convention:** a permanent ordinary grant saying “know,” “one language,” or a background language row grants spoken comprehension, speaking, reading and writing in the language's attested ordinary written form, unless expressly narrowed. Temporary understanding, basic ideas, fragmentary writing and magical communication give only their specific modes or meaning.

Orc and Orcish are one identity; Mycelic and Sporetongue are one. **NEW chosen interpretation of the book's option:** Imperial's Westreach, Eastern Sigil and Northern Vale use Common mechanically, while retaining their cultural/register labels. They do not consume extra choices or decode ciphers. “Mycelian” is an ancestry/legacy label, not an alias for Mycelic.

Trollish and Giant remain distinct. Deep Cant, Deep Speech, Murkish, Forgotten Script, Runic and Resonant Cant remain distinct. Shared letters, an ancient description or a similar name does not establish mutual comprehension or permission to select an otherwise restricted language.

**NEW Primordial policy:** general Primordial and Auran, Aquan, Ignan and Terran are independently known, related competencies. Knowing one does not automatically grant any of the others. Elemental-Touched chooses general Primordial **or** the dialect matching its already selected affinity: air/Auran, water/Aquan, fire/Ignan, earth/Terran. This fills one grant. Its Aquan is the same language an Amphibian knows. Other sources granting Primordial give general Primordial unless they expressly offer a dialect choice.

Gnomish and Orcish use Dwarvish script. Knowing its letters does not teach either language's grammar, meaning or cultural context. Where no named script is given, record a language-local orthography without inventing a lore name. **NEW written-competency completion:** Runic grants its attested written content; Forgotten Script must identify the actual admitted written tradition. Unspecified spoken forms remain unspecified. Recognizing or copying characters alone does not understand them.

No grant creates anatomy, a pheromone emitter, hearing, sight, hands, writing implements or a magical channel. Mycelic's description does not supply an invented biological ability. An ordinary flat ink page is not tactile-readable merely because its reader knows the language; an actual touch-reading spell exception has its own scope.

The published names The Voice and Resonant Cant retain their existing restrictions; this chapter grants neither ordinary enrollment nor an automatic class entitlement. Their meanings and deeper relationships remain deferred. No hidden-language list is created here.

## Learn a language

**NEW ordinary course:** choose one language/dialect and the modes sought. Identify the learner, the relevant script, legitimate access, and an actual qualified instructor or a complete usable curriculum. An instructor needs the modes taught and a mutually usable channel. Self-study needs authentic explanations, examples, exercises and a way to check their meaning. An unknown inscription, an isolated translation, money or an Insight balance is not a curriculum. Spoken practice needs actual production and correction; comprehension-only magic does not supply it.

| Module | Active work |
|---|---:|
| Spoken comprehension and production | 240 hours |
| Literacy after knowing the language's semantics | 80 hours |
| Script/orthography portion included in that literacy | 40 hours |
| Script familiarity alone, without semantics | 40 hours |

A complete new spoken-and-written language requires **320 active hours**, or **280** with genuine prior knowledge of that same script. Literacy for a semantically known language takes 80 hours, or 40 with that script already known. A written-only language uses 240 hours of written semantics plus the 80-hour literacy module and grants only its attested written modes. Related dialects give no automatic discount. An explicit grant bypasses study only for the modes it actually grants; valid starting knowledge incurs no retroactive fee.

Credit complete **15-active-minute phases**. Interruption loses the unfinished phase's prospective credit; previous credit survives, while real time, materials and fees remain spent. A shorter final phase is allowed only to finish the exact module after a real source-specific adjustment. Missing instruction, access or a usable channel yields no progress. Log real losses separately. Administrative phases do not break actual concentration or evade Oracle Tongues' actual save and ten-minute loss.

**NEW tuition reference:** 1 gp per eight actual instruction hours, including ordinary lesson consumables the provider actually supplies. A real quote or voluntary teacher may differ. Self-study has no invented tutor fee but needs actual materials. Pay for actual instruction time, including time an interruption made unproductive. Round each actual final purchase once upward to copper; do not round every phase separately. Prepaid time and refunds follow the actual agreement. A price does not conjure a teacher, rare text, permission or equipment.

Use actual time within eight-hour Watches and the two-active-work-Watch ceiling, with governing rest, Strain and access limits. The tutor is occupied too. A minute cannot also fund guarding, travel, beneficial rest, crafting, research, another course, gaining Insight or spending Insight without an explicit rule allowing that concurrency. No calendar-day shortcut, INT/PB discount or pending feat applies.

Completion is deterministic after genuine required work and authentic final practice, included in the last required phase. There is no random final fluency roll, added examination period or completion fee. Record the acquired modes and their source. Gain no XP, PB, Expertise, formula, spell, rank, faction permission or another language. Partial study can establish particular recorded words; it does not satisfy a requirement to know the language.

**Example:** an Orcish-literate learner studies Gnomish with a qualified teacher and usable lessons. Shared Dwarvish script reduces the course to 280 hours, reference tuition 35 gp. A 40-minute lesson interrupted during its third phase gives 30 credited minutes but consumes 40 actual minutes; one invoice at the reference rate costs 9 cp. An applicable Tongues failure later removing ten credited minutes remains a real loss.

## Understand, translate or decipher

Plain accessible speech or text in a known language needs no comprehension roll. That does not establish its truth, solve a code, authenticate it, reveal technical context or recover missing facts. Remembering a specific message understood through temporary magic preserves that information after the effect ends; general competence does not persist.

| Task | Procedure | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Copy visible characters | Actual access, tools, stock and time | A facsimile; no certified meaning or magical encoding |
| **NEW** ordinary prose translation | Source reading and destination writing; ten active minutes per 250 words, proportionately rounded up to a minute, minimum one | Plain noncoded prose in the destination language; no roll merely for translation |
| **NEW** uncertain recognition | One minute; normally INT/History, DC 10 familiar attested style, 15 supported related form, 20 damaged but diagnostic evidence | Supported identity or relationship; no translation |
| **NEW** Translate/Decipher project | One preregistered supported passage of at most 250 words; eight active hours; declared evidence, method, output and DC | Only the supported passage or cipher layer |

Routine obvious recognition needs no roll. A nondiagnostic specimen cannot reveal its identity through a high roll. Translation speed does not replace formula-copying, magical encoding or contract-authentication procedures.

For the eight-hour project, register the actual source meaning or finite supported meaning, relevant parallel/grammatical/key evidence and missing sections before work. Linguistic reconstruction uses INT/History: DC 15 supported related dialect, 20 unfamiliar but adequately evidenced language, 25 damaged yet recoverable correspondence. A separate mundane cipher uses INT/Investigation: DC 15 adequate known key, 20 constrained ordinary analysis, 25 difficult but genuinely solvable damaged/incomplete key. A plainly usable key may remove uncertainty; it does not provide a missing underlying language.

Declare one lead and one applicable PB contribution. **NEW project-specific assistance:** one qualified assistant contributes +1 after all eight hours of actually useful participation. This does not add assistants to other procedures. Apply the existing Core task degrees and natural shifts.

Success supplies only the registered supported result. Critical Success grants no second passage, fluency, extra meaning, code bypass or banked labor. Failure leaves notes and spent work, without a certified translation. Critical Failure has the same informational result plus only a genuinely predeclared, independently lawful hazard. No failure fabricates authoritative lore. An inaccessible or unsupported meaning makes the project unqualified before work; a destroyed gap stays a gap.

A fresh attempt requires genuinely new evidence or a concretely different supported method, and fresh required work. Changing readers, dates, copies or formatting alone does not create evidence or reset an unchanged failed attempt. Information genuinely discovered can support later work; past hours and rewards are never credited twice.

Formula research and copying retain their trade gates, DC, minimum research time and one-hour/1-sp copying rule. Scribing Insight uses its separate procedure below. A subject-limited background information feature is not general translation. Pending research/language feats give no current discount or bonus.

## Communicate in a scene

**NEW finite bound:** each creature's aggregate free ordinary speech/signing must fit at most **six seconds per numbered round**. Warnings, replies and extra turns share that allowance. Outside initiative use actual conversational time. Brief communication costs no additional Action, but cannot activate a feature, move you, grant a Reaction or interrupt an already resolved event. A spell's words follow that spell's casting procedure, without a new universal word cap.

Longer deliberate exchanges take an Action for each additional six-second segment on a turn with that Action available. Off-turn lengthy delivery requires a real applicable permission, such as a legitimately readied communication Action, or waits. Surprise keeps its printed brief-communication permission without granting an unavailable Action. Respect voice, hands, consciousness and all other actual restrictions.

An interpreter must first perceive and understand the incoming message, then produce a form the recipient can perceive and understand. A short source phrase and rendition may fit an interval; a long statement or multiple relays cannot arrive instantaneously. Record when meaning reaches each recipient. Late interpretation cannot retroactively qualify a resolved check or effect. A translator lends no fluency, bonus or mental link.

**NEW party signals:** ten active minutes of mutual demonstration/rehearsal establishes up to six recorded simple cues for the actual participants, such as halt, approach, retreat, danger, left and right. A one-hand cue requires that usable hand and a receiver who sees it; a two-hand cue requires both. Light, distance, cover and attention must support actual perception. Six cues do not teach a fluent sign language, arbitrary sentences or codebreaking. A formal sign language needs an actual source/course.

Player accessibility is free of fictional action costs: explaining your character's intent at the table is not the character speaking, signing, providing V or violating an oath. You need not perform a voice or gesture to declare its fictional use.

**Example:** in a six-second interval a three-second Aquan warning followed by a three-second Common rendition can reach the second listener at the end. A response cannot precede that receipt. A thirty-second explanation through two interpreters cannot qualify an attack that has already resolved. A Deafened ally who sees a rehearsed retreat cue receives that cue, without satisfying a feature requiring the ally to hear a performance.

## Hearing, silence and magic

| Restriction or permission | Actual consequence |
|---|---|
| Deafened | Cannot hear; language knowledge, reading, signs and otherwise eligible mental channels remain. It does not by itself prevent own speech or V. |
| Silenced | Prevents V, command words, Chants and audible coordination. **NEW explicit completion:** includes deliberate ordinary spoken messages. It does not itself forbid thought, reading, writing, signs or a separately valid mental effect. |
| Silence the Caster combat action | Prevents verbal-component Reactions through its printed window, with its actual concentration check. It does not suppress ordinary speech or legal Action-time V casting. |
| V component | Requires that caster's actual audible speech. An interpreter, sign, telepathic phrase, playback, mimicry or another speaker cannot supply it. |

S, F, material, hand and access requirements remain separate. An explicit class exception waives only its stated requirements. Language knowledge grants no casting access, RP, repertoire or formula. Track overlapping prohibitions separately with their own sources and expirations: an operation stays blocked while any applicable prohibition remains. Removing one effect does not remove another; identical restrictions do not add penalties or automatically extend durations.

Actor-specific verbal restrictions and a physical sound-suppression field differ. Neither automatically grants thunder immunity. Silence does not automatically end otherwise legal nonauditory concentration; a particular sustained audible performance may have stricter rules.

## Actual spell and ancestry interfaces

## Scribing, runes and devices

The reviewed [advanced operating guide](ADVANCED_CRAFT_CANDIDATE_GUIDE.md), [Scribing cards](../../data/crafting/advanced_craft_recipe_candidate_public.json) and [Tinkering cards](../../data/crafting/advanced_craft_recipe_candidate_public.json) retain their authority. The two card links open the supplied complete public advanced-crafting collection; use the actual recipe ID within it. Reading words does not establish a functional magical payload, caster eligibility or device control.

A properly encoded script supplies temporary repertoire for its one activation only to an otherwise qualified real caster who can read/understand its actual functional instructions. Class/rank/school, components, hand/access, RP and casting time still apply. Comprehension magic can meet only the eligible ordinary-language part of this test; its exclusions remain. Do not add the reference-consultation minute as an extra script casting cost.

A reference's bonus needs actual relevant content, availability and genuine necessary lead consultation of at least one minute, or the whole genuinely shorter task, under its self-production exclusion. Copying/translation makes an actual information copy, without transferring the original physical item's magic, charges, bonus or fresh study award. A printed zero-language effect remains zero.

The public **recipe-500** procedure awards one Language Insight after one active hour with legible, authenticated, genuinely useful parallel text into a language the researcher understands. Insight belongs to one researcher and target language, with a maximum of six unspent. Points cannot transfer to another researcher. The same underlying evidence awards once per reader across copies, holders, editions and magical recreations. Reaching the cap creates no deferred credit. Insight here is a specific ledger, separate from the Insight skill, XP or fluency.

Spend **three points for that language plus eight active hours** on one preregistered, supported, accessible and legible passage of at most 250 words, translating into a language the researcher knows. The Director must possess or establish its real source meaning. Missing meaning/evidence makes it unqualified before spending. This procedure adds no decipher roll. It grants the supported literal passage, without fluency, a separate cipher solution, hidden meaning, formula or spell. No hour also funds a course, a new Insight award, ordinary deciphering or formula work. A completed translation can later become genuine evidence; its old hours are not credited again.

Runic knowledge does not confer Runecarver's-tools proficiency, glyph-function knowledge or arm/disarm permission. Use actual tools, hands, inspection/disarm procedures, DCs and triggers. A failed translation does not automatically activate a rune; reading does not recharge it. Ward attunement and charge/Reaction timing remain separate.

**TI-04 controlled automata, not all crafted devices.** A TI-04 automaton requires an actual capable consenting controller with INT 6+ and ten active minutes using actual Tinker's tools at its legitimate accessible interface to register that controller and one compatible simple task. No proficiency is granted or required merely to use a known functioning interface. A previously bound chassis requires actual release by its controller or a separately completed lawful control procedure; ownership does not hack unknown, locked or hostile equipment. A controller may have three active ordinary crafted automata; separately defined special profiles and class devices keep only their own actual limits and exceptions. Traps, manually operated utilities and operator-driven machinery do not acquire this binding or attached-phase protocol merely because they are crafted devices. Use their own arming, direct-operation, activation and servicing procedures.

**In initiative**, an eligible automaton command requires a Bonus Action on the controller's regular turn, the configured visible/audible channel within 60 feet, and the actual shared one-command/one-offensive-companion-or-device allowance per owner per numbered round. Execution follows that controller's whole turn in the attached phase. Failed execution spends committed allowances; transfer, rebinding and extra turns do not refund them. Other item families retain every shared budget that their own controlling procedures expressly apply; this scope correction waives none.

**Outside initiative**, programming or reprogramming one such automaton's actual finite, physically possible noncombat task takes ten active minutes. Do not charge a second programming period for the unchanged task validly registered during initial binding. Starting one already programmed, wholly noncombat task uses an Action, not the combat Bonus Action command. Actual appendages, access, capacity and paid power/service intervals remain necessary. No professional work, autonomous attack, indefinite production or service reset follows from a program or language lesson. Fluency, an interpreter or a telepathic ally supplies neither control authority nor undocumented hardware. Service, repair and controller transfer remain separate and preserve their real histories, costs, HP, charges and custody.

**TD-08 is a separate class-device permission, not limited by this automaton-command scope.** It retains once per short rest, a Bonus Action, and up to two current Dissonance into one own active qualifying device within 30 feet. The completed source's actually armed charged trap, powered automaton, utility in a live eligible task, or aligned operator-driven device can qualify on its own terms. Merely carrying an idle item does not. Keep the original routing disable, clearance, service and resource histories; no class feature is granted here.

**Example:** with two prior Insight, study one new qualifying correspondence for an hour to reach three. Spend three and eight more hours on a supported 200-word passage: nine actual hours, zero new fluency-course hours, and zero Insight remaining. Reading a second physical copy of that same correspondence adds no point.
